title: Metafxclub AI Pixel HQ Full Agent Runtime

transport.browserToBridge: same-origin JSON over the loopback-only Local Bridge

endpoints.GET /api/agent-runtime/status: Return capability truth and fail-closed readiness for Chat, Workspace, Computer Use, MCP and plugins.
endpoints.GET /api/agent-runtime/models: Return only models and reasoning levels reported by the local Codex app-server and filtered by the backend allowlist.
endpoints.GET /api/agent-runtime/threads?agentId={: List the selected Agent's bounded sanitized thread summaries; includeArchived=true explicitly includes reversible archived history.
endpoints.POST /api/agent-runtime/threads: Create one durable Agent thread from exactly agentId, title, model, reasoning and mode.
endpoints.GET /api/agent-runtime/threads/{threadId: Read one bounded thread and its sanitized event timeline.
endpoints.POST /api/agent-runtime/threads/{threadI: Update the allowlisted model, reasoning level or capability mode while no turn is running; the exact current expectedRevision is required.
Upload one bounded image or file as strict base64 into the backend-owned immutable store. The browser never supplies or receives a filesystem path; only validated images may enter Chat turns.
endpoints.GET /api/agent-runtime/threads/{threadId: Return one thread-bound opaque artifact with no-store and nosniff headers. Cross-thread IDs return not found.
endpoints.POST /api/agent-runtime/threads/{threadI: Queue one idempotent user turn with optional opaque attachmentIds. Attachment IDs and hashes are part of the persisted turn request. Every real execution must be bound to a Mission, owner Agent, Audit events and a Report.
Request interruption of the exact active Codex turn and persist the request/result without inventing completion.
Set archived true or false without deleting history; the exact current expectedRevision is required.

chat.description: Tool-free conversation compatible with the existing guarded Agent Chat.

workspace.description: Workspace is visible but remains fail-closed until a one-shot user approval broker and UI bind every write or escalation.

computer.description: Computer Use is enabled only after an implemented HQ approval adapter can surface, bind and decide each request.

full.description: Workspace, MCP, plugins and Computer Use combined only when every adapter is verified and the HQ approval surface is active.

chatImageInput.readyWhen: The app-server is authenticated, an allowlisted selected model advertises image input, and the immutable artifact store is ready.

executionEvidence.successTerminalProof: turn/completed notification OR authoritative thread/read reconciliation
